subject: STABLE encode-cpu-opus: v2 sidecar built in place + device kernel-call breakdown line; gate-green 16:36-16:52; HEAVY RELEASE
body:
GATES
- run_host_tests: all passed, including the iOS strict link.
- CA: PASS. Render: 32. Async: 7/7.
- Integration: only the known CA pass failure.

CHANGES
1) render_encoder.inc tegu_generic_v2_build_job (handed over by root): builds into the caller's sidecar in place.
   - It clears only the entries it uses (~720 B each) instead of zeroing an 11.5 KB temporary and copying it out.
   - That waste happened twice per sidecar draw: at encode (a validation call whose sidecar is discarded) and at submit.
   - Callers discard 'out' on failure (checked all 3).
2) nord2_transport.inc: device line TEGU_PERF_KCALL, kernel calls by class as n/us: submit (SUBMIT_JM), wait (WAIT, WAIT_SEQ), sync, mem (ALLOC/RELEASE/IMPORT), map (map/unmap), other.
   - The next device log splits the 0.27 ms/job + 0.153 ms/draw into kernel versus userspace.
3) tools/frame_bench_main.m: FB_PROF_ENCODE=1 profiles the encoding phase.

ENCODE PROFILE (host, ca200, 2131 samples; next targets)
- 13% tegu_command_job: calloc of a chunk of 8 large Dispatch structs per 8 jobs.
- 11% memcpy in tegu_render_plan_generic_cached: plan 2848 B + spec 3360 B copied per memo hit.
- 11% self + 11% memcpy in tegu_render_generic_snapshot_rt.
- 12% objc_msg_lookup: host runtime dispatch, much cheaper on device.

Submit fit unchanged on frame_bench (its draws use no sidecars): 1.39 us/job + 0.82 us/draw.
